changes.title: Ask supported questions offline
changes.text: The UIMSD search accepts exact public-schema questions about counts, totals, averages, highs, lows and medians, optionally split by one public field. Results go into the existing question builder. Unsupported phrases and ambiguous or internal fields fail closed without silently dropping conditions.

changes.title: Protect question parsing and native selection
changes.text: Ten retained topic-search tests cover deterministic names, Unicode, unknown and hidden information, ambiguity, source-independent schemas and the generated query. The native UIMSD screen regression now taps the search control, enters a sample question and selects the result. Earlier aggregate and display-state tests remain.

changes.title: Preserve verified UIMSD audit evidence
changes.text: Retain all audits, fixtures, core verification records and reviewed paths since the immediately previous compiled TEST278 APK. No prior verified history is removed, no scoring or gameplay is changed, and private build evidence is separate from publication or physical-phone results.
